VI.description: Asks a Web Browser control for the title of the page it shows, through Execute JavaScript. Page Title is that title once the document has finished loading, (no title) for a loaded page without one, and Previous Title while the document is still loading, while the browser shows its initial about:blank page, or while the browser cannot run scripts yet (Error 53 right after its panel opens). Ready? is TRUE when the browser answered the script at all. Script errors are expected while the browser starts and are NOT reported: error out is error in, and an error in skips the script.

FreeLabel.comment: Keeps Previous Title until a page has loaded

Control.description: Reference to the Web Browser control to ask.
Title returned while no loaded page can be read; normally the last Page Title.
An error here skips the script and is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: Title of the loaded page, (no title) for a loaded page without one, otherwise Previous Title.
TRUE when the browser answered the script, i.e. it can run scripts and navigate.
error in, passed through. Script errors are not reported.
